subject: Capacity squeeze: Dedicated pool headroom pressure (LumenFin reserved shortfall)
messages:
From: Claire Harris <claire.harris@lumenfin.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@lumenfin.com
Date: 2026-07-22T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Increased errors & latency this AM — reserved throughput not honored

Hi Hannah,

We're seeing a sustained latency increase and a spike in 5xx errors across our inference endpoints since ~06:30 PT. Our dashboard shows queued tokens and a lower effective throughput than what we reserved (monthly committed capacity). This is affecting two payment-critical flows; payments are timing out and customer support is receiving a flood of incidents.

Can you confirm why LumenFin is dropping below reserved throughput? We expected reserved capacity to be isolated from noisy neighbors. Please escalate — we need an immediate mitigation plan and an ETA for a durable fix.

I have attached a short sample of the logs and the usage snapshot.

Claire Harris
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenFin
claire.harris@lumenfin.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: error-rate-sample-logs.txt (text), pool-usage-2026-07-22.csv (csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Harris <claire.harris@lumenfin.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increased errors & latency this AM — reserved throughput not honored

Claire — thanks for the signal and the logs. We're treating this as high priority. Short summary of immediate actions while we investigate root cause: 

- Opening an incident bridge now (ops + infra + sales) — invite going to you in 5 minutes.
- Engineering will check reserved-capacity enforcement and shed/fallback policies; preliminary ask: will you accept a temporary model variant downgrade for non-critical flows? That can reduce token consumption by ~30-40%.
- We'll push a KV-prefix cache flush+warm for your top 10 routes to reduce cache misses.
- We'll temporarily increase dedicated burst capacity for LumenFin (30 minutes) while we validate. If we confirm platform-side scheduling issue, we'll issue a credit for impacted hours.

Jonas and Karthik: see Claire's logs. Please prioritize enforcement check (quota vs. runtime routing) and identify whether any colocated pools are over-allocating. Marissa: please prepare a customer note and a short credit proposal once we have impact sizing.

I'll keep you posted on the bridge outcome in <30m.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: LumenFin reserved-capacity shortfall — immediate asks

Team — thread on LumenFin production impact (see Claire's original below). TL;DR: customer reserved pool is not providing expected throughput; experiencing increased latency and 5xx rate. Impact: payment flow timeouts. Customer is on an enterprise reserved contract (LN-2026-0031).

First-priority checklist (ask for 9:15 bridge):
1) Enforcement check: confirm that reserved allocation for LN-2026-0031 is pinned to an isolated GPU pool and that runtime routing is honoring it. Share the current allocation snapshot (gpu_id -> active_sessions).
2) Telemetry: gather token queue length, per-route token throughput, and kernel-level stalls in last 60m. Export to /tmp/lumenfin-telemetry-20260722.csv.
3) Fallback validation: prepare a canary config for model-variant fallback (gpt-small -> gpt-medium-quant) and an execution plan for canary rollout.

Please prepare the config and be ready to test in the bridge.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed-fallback-plan.md (markdown)
